overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a robust and highly targeted professional social media presence focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and social media analysis. Across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, he reaches a total audience of 3,580 followers. His content consistently resonates with academic, technical, and professional audiences, yielding a strong overall average engagement rate of 5.32%. Posts announcing research breakthroughs, funding successes, software updates, and academic opportunities drive the highest interactions.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of newly published papers and presentations on disinformation and coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Technical releases and methodological discussions, such as updates to the CooRnet tool.

recommendations: Prioritize Bluesky for launching new research papers and academic calls, as the platform's community demonstrates the highest propensity to share and engage with academic content.
Utilize LinkedIn's larger professional network to amplify high-profile achievements, such as grant wins and recruitment, which secure the highest absolute interaction volume.
Include call-to-actions or direct links to application portals and repositories across all platforms to translate high engagement rates into direct actions.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky acts as the most engaging channel, boasting an average engagement rate of 6.14%. It shows highly active peer-to-peer amplification through reposts, particularly for new papers and PhD opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides solid niche engagement (average 4.55% ER) within specialized academic circles (specifically via the aoir.social instance). It is highly effective for tool announcements like CooRnet v2.0.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn represents the largest audience base (1,850 followers) and drives the highest absolute interaction numbers (up to 107 interactions on a single post). It serves as the primary platform for institutional news and talent acquisition.
